name: NFC Tap Builder by Tap.Giving
description: A tool first: create print-ready NFC artwork proofs with correct vector art for organizations, including churches, nonprofits, restaurants, coffee shops, and local businesses, free to take to any vendor, with no lock-in. Discovery, pricing, product facts, artwork spec, and order questions are keyless; recap and order status are keyed reads. Ordering custom discs through Tap.Giving is an optional next step; order placement uses an organization API key.
author: Tap.Giving
